notes.state_map: Orissa -> Odisha (renamed); Telangana -> Andhra Pradesh (2011 census pre-dates the 2014 bifurcation, so Telangana districts reside under Andhra Pradesh in the boundary file).
notes.district_map: Model district names are legacy/colonial-era spellings as in the original dataset. Each maps to the 2011 Census name used by the DataMeet boundary file. Slash-separated dual names map to the boundary's primary name.
notes.unmatched_provenance: Districts with no single valid modern geometry are intentionally left unmatched and reported rather than forced into a modern district. 'Bombay' maps to 'Mumbai' as the direct successor city district (renamed, same geography).
notes.authoritative_source: Model district names taken from data/processed/final_crop_resilience_district_year.csv; boundary names taken from DataMeet Census 2011 district shapefile (data/geodata/2011_Dist.shp).
